title: God of War
summary: White specks on characters in dim light: an EQUAL depth test after a prepass, which the translated shaders do not match bit for bit. The fix loosens that test only for the stencil references of characters and small objects (0x01, 0x03), so grass and leaves stay right (2026-11-16).

credits.name: The author of "God Of War 2018 White Dot Fix (through Crossover)" on r/macgaming
credits.note: Found the depth test behind the white specks.

excerpts.note: Every depth state that tests EQUAL is kept, and a twin with the replacement test read from gow-depth-fix.ini is made beside it.
The twin is bound only when the stencil reference is one of stencil_refs: characters and small objects, not grass and leaves.
